items.name: SAWIS BI
items.stack: PHP, MySQL, legacy Mapper sync, import/export
items.problem: The South African wine industry needs import, export, and domestic data in one production system. Source of truth for a large cut of that data is a legacy Mapper system. The business depends on that data landing correctly every month, and on import/export jobs completing.
items.responsibility: Tech Lead. I do the majority of the backend. I own the destination database and application path: monthly synchronisation from Mapper into our MySQL (tables over two million rows), import/export jobs, and recovery when a run fails. I own planning, estimation, technical decisions, and delivery, including annual feature phases (major domestic-data work in 2026).
items.decisions: Treat Mapper as the client's legacy extractor; own load, schema, validation, and repair on our side so a failed month can be traced through PHP and MySQL instead of guessed.
items.leadership: I coordinate a project manager, a senior frontend engineer, and a senior backend engineer. I am the client-facing technical owner.
items.outcome: Monthly Mapper syncs and wine-industry import/export continue in production on tables over two million rows. Failed jobs get a recovered data path. Annual phases, including 2026 domestic data, ship under this lead.
items.blurb: Tech Lead. Monthly Mapper → MySQL sync. Tables over 2 million rows. Majority of backend. PM + senior FE + senior BE.

items.name: Indawo
items.stack: PHP, Laravel / legacy PHP, MySQL, Docker, Azure VM, CI/CD
items.problem: A production PHP product had to stay up for a client I own. The original on-prem host failed. Delivery still needed spec, cost, and sign-off, not only tickets.
items.responsibility: I own the client relationship for engineering: planning, estimation, technical decisions, and delivery. I operate the application and guest OS.
items.decisions: On hardware failure I containerised the legacy app with Docker on spare CentOS and restored publishing the same incident. The app now runs on an Azure VM; I operate the guest OS.
items.leadership: Client-facing owner. Pull requests and a post-deploy health window.
items.outcome: Production restored after host failure; still running. Delivery loop from spec to sign-off remains mine.
items.blurb: Client-owned production app. Docker restore after host failure. Spec through sign-off.

items.blurb: Freelance Terraform for a production PHP fleet. Separate from Overdrive.
